description: Temporal authority registry for Indian law containing statute commencement, repeal dates, section-level supersession mappings (including 2024 IPC->BNS, CrPC->BNSS, IEA->BSA recodification), and normalized citation strings.

statutes.description: 14 primary Indian statutes with in-force intervals and repeal links.

sections.description: Statute sections/articles with headings, official numbers, and text.

supersession.description: Section-level mappings across legal reforms (1:1, 1:N, N:1, repealed_no_successor).

citation_strings.description: Empirical citation strings extracted from Supreme Court / High Court corpus with target mappings.
